Seer.rationale_short: Once you establish a Trusted Core, any player attacking that core is a primary target.

Guard.rationale_short: Your sole priority is the Seer. Protecting the Witch while the Seer is alive is a strategic error.

Witch.rationale_short: Poison must never be used on the Seer or any member of the Trusted Core.
Save potions are for the Seer or confirmed clears only.

Villager.rationale_short: Always prioritize the Seer's mechanical results over a player's willingness to vote for a suspect.

dropped.advice_verbatim: Your initial reveal and clearance of the Guard were correct
be aware that wolves will 'bus' their own teammates (as seen with Hoang) to gain trust
